cards.claim: Tania Azadi attended the Jagiellonian University.
cards.quote: She had always been drawn to the Jagiellonian University, with its rich legacy of intellectual curiosity and its stunning Gothic architecture that seemed to whisper secrets to those who listened closely. As a researcher, she had spent countless hours within these walls, unraveling the mysteries of the past and forging new paths of inquiry. As she poured over the ancient text, Tania's mind began to wander back to her own journey, from the bustling streets of Tehran to the historic streets of Krakow. It was as if the very stones of the Jagiellonian University had whispered a welcome, acknowledging a kindred spirit in this young, inquisitive mind.
